items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Jonesy -- Jonesy was so devoted to Duke. And Duke used to keep that man out all night

ctx.x: Retribution always gets you in the end, you know? Jonesy -- Jonesy was so devoted to Duke. And Duke used to keep that man out all night in -- to be with him, to guard him because he -- he always feel that somebody's going to beat him up or something. And he wanted Jonesy around him to help him out. And, when Jonesy was dying, I remember this -- [anyway] out here, California, and his wife couldn't see him, they hid Jonesy from his wife and his wife had to go and get a lawyer and she was -- used to work for the…
How many years was he with you, from 1927 to when?
